name: Searing Smite

header.Casting Time: Bonus Action, which you take immediately after hitting a target with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

casting.casting_time: Bonus Action, which you take immediately after hitting a target with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike

authored_intent: Bonus Action immediately after melee weapon/Unarmed Strike hit; extra Fire to triggering hit; turn-start Fire then CON save ends on success; higher slots scale initial and ongoing dice; no Concentration or invented action-extinguish ending.

rules.text: As you hit the target, it takes an extra 1d6 Fire damage from the attack.
At the start of each of its turns until the spell ends, the target takes 1d6 Fire damage and then makes a Constitution saving throw.
On a failed save, the spell continues.
On a successful save, the spell ends.
All the damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 1.
